note: The registry of every test group, evaluation, harness and evaluation data folder of ChatSOP (owner request 2026-10-03). Maintained by hand; validated and rendered by `node tools/inventory/tests-and-evals.mjs` (writes docs/tests-inventory.html); `tests/project/tests-inventory.test.mjs` fails when a test file, a tools/eval or tools/capabilities file, an eval/ data folder, a verify job or a package script is not mapped here, or when an entry names a missing path. A latest result is copied from the named report with its date; an entry without one says `no recorded run`. Test-group runtimes and results come from `node tools/inventory/tests-and-evals.mjs measure`.

kinds.unit: unit test (stubs, no model, no network)
kinds.integration: integration test or executable check (several components, a local server or native solvers, no model)
kinds.offline-regression: offline regression: recorded model answers replayed (record/replay), no model call
kinds.capability-battery: capability battery: SOP Lang executed by the engines against the oracle or a procedural gold
kinds.live-eval: live evaluation with model calls through Ploinky Workers
kinds.benchmark: benchmark: timings or arm comparisons at scale
kinds.data-audit: data or repository audit (validators, rights, overlap, review of model output)
kinds.support: shared helpers, fixtures and runners of other entries

components.formalizer: Formalizer, step by step (LocalLLMStepByStep, InternalReasoningStepByStep, protocol data, request parser, query author)
components.routed-paths: Routed paths (structure route, path B, jsEval, FOL, engineCode)
components.conversation: Conversation, small talk and the chat turn (reply memory, behaviour layer, pragmatics)
components.memory: Memory engines, base memories, sessions and slice retrieval
components.ingestion: Ingestion of documents and knowledge authoring
components.server-ui: Server and UI (HTTP API, pages, auth, feedback)
components.docs-specs: Docs and specs (wire help, API examples, spec references, site links)
components.sop-language: SOP Lang (parser, lowering, runtime semantics, knowledge grammar)
components.eval-tooling: Evaluation tooling itself (scorers, generators, harness libraries)
components.project: Project process and hygiene (journal, notes, shards, leakage, rights)
components.pworker: Ploinky Workers integration (lib/pworker.mjs, model entries, the no-direct-model-calls rule)
components.mrp: The MRP layer (lib/mrp: Models, slots and strategies, the turn pipeline; server/mrp-routes.mjs; /models)

ignoredScripts.test:fast: the fast subset of npm test: every folder but engines, reasoning, memory and eval-tooling (about a third of the time)
ignoredScripts.test:full: the same run as npm test
